finding.summary: New `DateCell` component (preference-driven text + `title` tooltip) has no test at all
finding.evidence: `DateCell` is the whole point of the feature in the list: it calls `useDateFormat()`, renders `formatListDate(value, format)` and sets `title={formatFullDateTime(value)}` (document-list.tsx:240-247). The added tests only cover the pure helpers (tests/app/documents/document-list-utils.test.ts) and the store (tests/lib/date-format-preference.test.ts). Nothing renders `DateCell` or `dateColumn`'s cell, so the acceptance criterion "both columns carry a `title` tooltip with the full localized date+time in every format" is unverified — swapping the two formatters, dropping `title=`, or passing the wrong value would leave the suite green. The frontend also has no `tsc` lane, so a wrong prop wouldn't be caught elsewhere either. Searched: tests/app/documents/ contains only document-list-utils.test.ts and tab-name.test.ts; grep for `DateCell`/`document-list` across packages/frontend returns no test file.

verdict.reason: No test anywhere in the repo renders `DateCell` or `dateColumn`'s cell. `DateCell` (document-list.tsx:240-247, used at :269) is module-local and unexported; grep repo-wide for `DateCell` matches only those two source lines plus the task doc. The added tests cover only pure helpers (tests/app/documents/document-list-utils.test.ts) and the preference store/hook (tests/lib/date-format-preference.test.ts, which uses renderHook, never a cell). I also checked the places the reviewer did not: colocated src tests (src/app/documents/__tests__/* and src/app/documents/*.test.ts) — none import document-list; the only importers of document-list are src/app/documents/page.tsx:6 and src/app/workspaces/workspace-documents.tsx:7, neither reached by any test; and the browser lanes (test:visual:browser / test:interaction / test:hunt-oracles / test:webkit in packages/frontend/package.json, driven by scripts/verify-*.mjs against src/app/harness/*) contain no documents-list or date scenarios (grep for Modified|Created|formatListDate|date-format in scripts/ and harness/ returns nothing). No playwright config or root e2e dir exists. So the wiring the feature actually ships — hook-driven format selection plus title={formatFullDateTime(value)}, the explicit acceptance criterion at docs/tasks/active/20260812-date-display-format-todo.md:26-29 — is unverified: dropping `title=` or swapping the two formatters would leave the suite green. Render tests are idiomatic here (src/app/documents/__tests__/upload-panel.test.tsx, src/app/analytics/document-analytics.test.tsx), so this is a genuine missing-test gap for a new behavior, squarely in the test-adequacy lane.
